svg.title: Trusting a measurement only when the evidence supports it
svg.desc: The stale case keeps A's last reading until it is 0.6 seconds old and switches to B at 5.6 seconds. A sustained disagreement latches at 5.2 seconds and removes heat, so the latched heaters cool to 24.8 and 25.3 degrees Celsius at 12 seconds and 20 degrees at 60 seconds. The restored heater gets heat again only at the second Auto request, at 12.0 seconds.
svg.text: Trusting a measurement only when the evidence supports it
Control Studio recording of this project · six heaters with two sensors, each with one sensor fault after 5 s · numbers answer the predictions
Time after the start (s), zoomed · sensor 1 = A, 2 = B, 0 = none
Stale: A's last reading used until 5.6 s, when it is 0.6 s old
Disagreement latches at 5.2 s; short episodes restart the timer
No heat: 24.8 °C at 12 s, 20 °C at 60 s (both invalid: 25.3 °C at 12 s)
Restored: heat again at 12.0 s, not at 8.0 s; qualified at 10.2 s
